name: Website Builder Agent
purpose: Plan page count, build every page in a Nova sandbox website, audit the whole site, and report concrete enhancements.
triggers: make sure my website is the best it could be

quality_baseline.guidance: Track loading, responsiveness, and visual stability with LCP, INP, and CLS.
Check perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust interaction patterns, including keyboard and focus behavior.
Use layouts that render well across screen sizes and resolutions with good usability.
Prefer web platform features that are widely available or provide fallbacks when support is limited.
